title: Good Citizenship in School
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use real class situations, never naming a learner as a bad example.

skills.key_step: The child names the qualities of a good school citizen from what a learner does (respect, honesty, responsibility, helping, care for property).

floor.prerequisite: Knows the values of the school.
floor.question: Name one value of our school.
floor.answer: any value such as respect or honesty

representations: a class chart "a good citizen does..."
a role play of welcoming a new learner
steps: Ask whether it helps the school and others.
Say what a good citizen would do if the action was poor.
contexts: helping a learner who has fallen
switching off a tap left running

board.do: Write: "Otieno switched off a running tap."
Wait for responsibility or care for property.
Write the quality and add it to the chart.

listen_for: Only the learner with the top marks
misconceptions.ask: Who is a good citizen in school?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what a learner can do for others even with low marks.

misconceptions.ask: Which learner is a good citizen?
misconceptions.repair: Role play a learner who sees someone bullied: what is the good action?

listen_for: Say nothing, because telling tales is wrong
misconceptions.ask: You see a learner being bullied. What does a good citizen do?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: is it gossip to tell a teacher that someone is being hurt?

listen_for: The learner with the new bag
misconceptions.ask: Who is a good citizen in school: a learner with a new bag, or a learner who helps others and keeps the class clean?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what each learner does for the school.

checks.question: Give two qualities of a good citizen in school.
checks.answer: any two of: respect, honesty, responsibility, helping others, care for property, being on time

checks.question: Is a learner who reports bullying to a teacher a good citizen?
